text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired automatically for service=redwood-inference-heads cluster=c-prod region=us-east1 — metric=request_queue_depth (window=3m) crossed threshold (75%). PD INC-8921 -> https://pd.redwood/INC-8921

pagerduty: [AUTO] Alert: inference-headpool-requests-high — urgent, no ack yet.

mona: ack'ing and taking primary. paging @kyle @alice @ben-sre. Starting quick triage. :eyes:

kyle: ack — oncall. pulling queue and autoscaler graphs. link to dashboard: https://dash.redwood/infer/queue?range=30m

alice: quick note — customers on c-prod-us-east1 are showing increased tail latency and a few 429s (small spike). I see pending requests steadily climbing on headpool-1; current queue depth ~8200, target healthy ~<2000.

kyle: autoscaler shows repeated scale attempts: attempted scale at 1829000900 -> requested +8 pods, kube reported failed pod startups with `FailedCreatePod` due to `Insufficient cpu` on nodepool; cloud provider reports node provisioning in progress but instances stuck in PROVISIONING for >2m.

ben-sre: hitting GCP quota? I see many spot preemptions earlier. Checking project compute quota and reservation usage.

opsbot: system: recent events: {"time":"1829000850","event":"spot_reclaim","zone":"us-east1-b","affected":6} — automatic replacement attempted.

mona: impact assessment: medium-to-high. Some latency-sensitive tenants (batch inference less affected) — realtime endpoints for a subset of customers likely seeing degraded experience. We should notify SRE and Product.

kyle: mitigation options:
1) manual inflate nodepool (add 4 on-demand nodes) — fastest immediate headroom.
2) temporarily lower minReplica/instantiation grace to accept smaller instance types.
3) route non-authenticated or lower priority traffic to dedicated fallback model variant (smaller quantized model) to reduce per-request CPU/GPU load.

alice: I can flip routing rules for non-critical routes to fallback variant for the next 10m. That should cut pressure by ~30%. Will also increase prefix-cache TTL to reduce recompute for repeated prompts.

ben-sre: I'm requesting quota bump and starting manual node creation: command I ran (monitoring):
```bash
gcloud compute instances create inference-ephemeral-1 inference-ephemeral-2 inference-ephemeral-3 inference-ephemeral-4 --zone=us-east1-b --machine-type=n1-standard-16 --image-family=redwood-infer-node --labels=ephemeral=incident2026
```
Started creation at ~1829001180.

kyle: thanks. also lowering cluster-autoscaler scale-down aggressiveness to avoid churn: `kubectl patch configmap cluster-autoscaler --patch '{"data":{"scaleDownUtilizationThreshold":"0.1"}}'` (temporarily).

mona: posting initial PD update: "Investigation: queue depth increasing due to node provisioning delays and spot reclamations. Mitigation: manual node add + traffic routing to fallback models. Customer impact: elevated latency and transient 429s for a subset of realtime endpoints. Working now — will post progress updates."

incident-bot: PD INC-8921 update posted.

kyle: node creation events: 2 nodes moved to RUNNING at 1829001265, remaining 2 still provisioning, kube shows new capacity added to nodepool at 1829001280. Pods draining queue assignment started.

alice: flipped routing for non-critical model variants at 1829001295 — traffic rerouted, prefix-cache TTL bumped. Seeing immediate drop in CPU utilization for headpool-1 clients.

opsbot: telemetry: queue depth trending down from 8200 -> 5400 in 90s, pending requests average wait dropped from 1.8s -> 0.9s.

ben-sre: last node finished provisioning at 1829001333. autoscaler now stabilizing. Confirmed no `FailedCreatePod` in last 2m.

kyle: good. continuing observation window for 10m. Next steps: leave manual nodes for 30m then evaluate scale-in, follow up with quota request ticket for region.

mona: @oncall-ops, please coordinate customer comms for any customers seeing errors. I've created INCIDENT-8921 internal doc and assigned to triage.

alice: routing change rollback plan: will keep fallback routing live until queue <1500 for 5m consecutive. I'll roll back then and monitor.

ben-sre: filing quota ticket now (https://console.cloud/quota/req/65432) and adding note about spot fallback config.

kyle: summary for PD update: mitigation in place, queue draining, added 4 on-demand nodes, traffic partially routed to fallback variants, ongoing observation. Will update when stable or if regression.

mona: handing off to @kyle for 1h watch. I need to step off for another meeting. kyle, take ownership and update PD when status changes. :white_check_mark:

kyle: taking over. setting recurring checks and watch. If queue climbs above 60% again we'll re-open escalation.

incident-bot: Note: Handoff recorded — current owner=kyle, handoff_ts=1829001420.

kyle: atm tail latency down to 95th=420ms, error 429s reduced to baseline. continuing to monitor until last_message_ts.

mona: thanks team.
